exposure: type of cesarean section (emergent vs elective)
cohort: 212 patients who underwent emergent or elective cesarean delivery
finding: There was no significant difference in postoperative pain intensity, analgesic requirements, or patient satisfaction between general and spinal anesthesia for both emergent and elective cesarean sections.
mod_finding: The type of anesthesia used during cesarean section (general vs spinal) did not significantly affect postoperative pain.
